# `00-data/` — data directory

This folder holds the raw and intermediate datasets used by the analysis
pipeline. **Its contents are intentionally not versioned** (see `.gitignore`:
`00-data/*`), because the files are large and/or subject to a separate data
license (`LICENSE-data`). Only this README is tracked.

To reproduce the analysis you must place the raw inputs here with the file
names listed below.

## Raw inputs (provided; not generated by the pipeline)

| File | Read by | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vol_par_surv.csv` | `01.1c-PAR_extintion.R`, `01.2a-survival_growth.R`, `01.2b-biomass.R`, `01.2d-shrub_size.R` | Main survival / size / PAR table (`Individual`, `quercus_sp`, …). |
| `sup_growth_may2026.csv` | `01.2a-survival_growth.R` | Third census (may 2026). |
| `growth.csv` | `01.2a-survival_growth.R` | Raw growth measurements (`rD.growth`). |
| `shrub_biomass.csv` | `01.2b-biomass.R` | Raw biomass (`rD.biomass`). |
| `shrub_SLA.csv` | `01.2c-SLA.R` | Raw specific leaf area (`rD.sla`). |
| `wood_density.csv` | `01.2f-wood_density.R` | Raw wood density (`rD.wood_density`). |
| `shrubs_gps.csv` | `01.1b-elevation.R` | Shrub GPS coordinates and elevation. |
| `par_shrubs_time_open.csv` | `01.1c-PAR_extintion.R` | PAR time series under open gap (**latin1**). |
| `par_shrubs_time_pine.csv` | `01.1c-PAR_extintion.R` | PAR time series under pine canopy (**latin1**). |
| `datos_humedad_temperatura_tamajon.csv` | `01.1a.3-add_microsite_environment.R` | Datalogger metadata (**latin1**, bytes are not valid UTF-8). |
| `dataloggers/*.xlsx` | `01.1a.1-merge_dataloggers.R` | Raw datalogger exports (one sheet named `Lista` each). |

## Intermediate outputs (written by the pipeline)

| File | Written by | Consumed by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dataloggers/combined_dataloggers.csv` | `01.1a.1-merge_dataloggers.R` | `01.1a.3-add_microsite_environment.R` (via `combined`) |
| `boot_RII.csv` | `01.2e-RII.R` (export step) | `03.3-RII.R`, `Results04_RII_2.qmd` |
| `summ.elevation.csv` | `02.1-elevation.R` | — |

## Legacy files (no longer referenced by any script)

`boot_RII_qi.csv`, `boot_RII_qf.csv`, `par_extintion.csv`, `df.microclima.csv`.
These are kept for reference only and are not read or written anywhere in
`01-scripts/`.
